## About
Corvette Corner is a Rowlett shop built around one car. We're committed to Corvette repair and to serving you with quality and value. Reviewers know the owner as Rich, and you'll usually find a garage full of Corvettes being worked on.
Our mechanics are ASE Master Certified and have years of experience. Most of all, they love Corvettes and care about yours. We may not be related, but you'll feel like we're family.
Bring your Corvette in for an evaluation. Customers have given us a 4.5 rating from 22 Google reviews.

## Services
- Restoration Service: Restoration work for Corvettes of all year models.
- Driveability Diagnosis & Repair: Tracking down why your Corvette isn't running right, then fixing it.
- Performance Mods: Performance modifications are available for your Corvette.
- Preventative maintenance: We offer many preventative maintenance options. It's the convenient way to keep your Corvette healthy and in top condition.
- A/C Repair
- Engine Repair

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Appointments are preferred, so give us a call before you bring your Corvette by.

Q: Do you work on older Corvettes?
A: Yes. We offer restoration, performance and maintenance for all year models.

Q: My Corvette broke down. Can you get it to the shop?
A: A reviewer whose Corvette broke down on the roadway said Rich got it carefully towed to the shop and diagnosed the issue. Call us and we'll talk it through.
